name: lunan-aidb
description: Lunan AIDB — AI-native MySQL/MariaDB desktop IDE with local memory and a database time machine
author: 路南 <https://github.com/guanyisheng>

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:all: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && TMPDIR=/tmp CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --config.directories.output=/tmp/lunan-aidb-dist
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run build && TMPDIR=/tmp CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --dir --config.directories.output=/tmp/lunan-aidb-dist
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && TMPDIR=/tmp CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --config.directories.output=/tmp/lunan-aidb-dist
scripts.dist:beta: npm run build && TMPDIR=/tmp CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --win --x64 --config.directories.output=/tmp/lunan-aidb-dist
